en: Divided‑back Romanian postcard. The image side is a sepia studio portrait of a seated woman looking up at a small child standing on a draped pedestal, the child wearing a simple white garment and a cross necklace. A Romanian caption appears on the image, with publisher credits at the bottom. The address side is printed in red with 'ROMANIA Carte poștală', a stamp box, address lines, and publisher/series information.
